مميزات الشمع:

·       تجربة الطبيعة الخام: عسل بشمعه كما خلقه الله، يمنحك تجربة تذوق استثنائية (من الخلية إليك مباشرة).

·       نكهة التراث: طعم السدر العسيري الأصيل الذي يعيدك لذكريات الزمن الجميل، بنكهة مركزة وطبيعية .

لمن هذا العسل؟

✅ لعشاق العسل في صورته التقليدية (أقراص الشمع) والباحثين عن الفائدة الكاملة .

✅ لمن يعانون من مشاكل الجيوب الأنفية واللثة (المضغ مفيد جداً لصحة الفم).

✅ هدية فاخرة جداً (قدر الشمع) تبيّض الوجه وتقدم للأحباب وكبار السن كرمز للكرم.

طريقة الاستخدام والحفظ:

·       اقتطع قطعة صغيرة بمقدار ملعقة، وامضغها جيداً كالعلكة للاستمتاع بطعم العسل وللاستفادة من خواص الشمع العلاجية، يفضل تناوله صباحاً.

·       تنبيه: يفضل استخدام ملعقة أو سكين نظيفة وجافة تماماً عند القطع للحفاظ على خواص العسل.

·       لأننا نضمن لك رحلة العسل من الخلية إلى باب بيتك بأعلى معايير النقل والتخزين، لتصلك الفائدة كما هي في الطبيعة.

·       تخزين احترافي: مستودعاتنا مهيأة بدرجات حرارة مثالية تحافظ على تماسك أقراص الشمع وإنزيمات العسل الحية.

What is the source of Al-Osaimi Sidr honey and why is it called Al-Osaimi and Royal honey?

This type of honey with wax comes from the extract of bees collecting the flowers of Sidr trees in the Al-Osaimat area in Amran Governorate in Yemen. It is nicknamed “Royal” because it is the most luxurious and expensive type of honey, and it has its own and continuing patrons, including the wealthy, notables, and businessmen.


Why is Sidr Al Osaimi honey considered the most expensive type of honey in the world?

  1. Al-Osaimi honey is famous for its high price due to the high demand for it among businessmen, especially the elderly, in the Gulf countries.
  2. Low annual supply.
  3. It is difficult to obtain it except on special recommendations by travelers to Yemen.
  4. It is considered one of the very luxurious and precious gifts that honors the face of its owner to the recipient.


What distinguishes Sidr Al-Osaimi wax honey from other honeys?

  1. This honey is characterized by being the most delicious honey you can taste among dozens of honey varieties on the market, according to the testimony of many honey experts and honey customers.
  2. Sidr Al-Osaimi honey is superior to Sidr Hadrami honey in quality, taste and efficiency, according to the testimony of those who know it.
  3. It is suitable for luxurious gifting , especially gifts for couples about to get married, parents, prominent figures, and businessmen and women.
  4. The wax from honey is natural and produced by bees, and this causes a lack of supply and high costs for merchants, and because producing wax from bees takes time, unlike the installation of imported artificial wax in some apiaries, which helps to raise productivity.
  5. We are proud of our distinctive specialization in the market in selling this luxurious type of honey after examining it in the honey quality laboratory and ensuring its safety before putting it up for sale. This is what distinguishes us most in your store, Rawdat Al-Jabal Honey.


Is pure Osaimi honey better or waxed?

Wax is tastier and more nutritious than pure honey.

والتي تقدم عسل المانوكا الطبيعي، ولديها عضوية في منظمة منتجي عسل المانوكا UMFHA النيوزلندية.


عسل المانوكا تم إنتاجه وحصاده وتعبئته من داخل نيوزيلندا، ويتم اختبار جودة كل دفعة منه بشكل مستقل، مما يعني أنه يمكنك التأكد تمامًا أن ما تتلقاه هو عسل المانوكا الأصلي 100٪ ، ويلبي الاختبار المتطلبات التي حددتها كل من حكومة نيوزيلندا ووزارة الصناعات الأولية بنيوزلندا (MPI) ورابطة منتجي عسل مانوكا النيوزلندي UMFHA.


ماذا يعني ال UMF في عسل المانوكا؟

UMF اختصار ل (Unique Manuka Factor) ويعني عامل مانوكا الفريد وهو مقياس يُستخدم لتحديد قوة وفعالية عسل المانوكا.

يتم تحديدال UMF من قبل جمعية عسل مانوكا النيوزيلندية هذه الجمعية هي الجهة المعترف بها رسميًا والمسؤولة عن اختبار وتصنيف عسل المانوكا بناءً على معايير صارمة لضمان الجودة، العسل الذي يحمل تصنيف UMF يتم اختباره في مختبرات معتمدة من قبل الجمعية.


ماذا يعني ال MGO في عسل المانوكا؟

MGO اختصار ل (Methylglyoxal) ويعني ميثيل جليوكسال وهو مركب طبيعي يُعتبر المكون الأساسي ا في عسل المانوكا.

تم تحديدال MGO من قبل جمعية عسل مانوكا النيوزيلندية هذه الجمعية هي الجهة المعترف بها رسميًا والمسؤولة عن اختبار وتصنيف عسل المانوكا بناءً على معايير صارمة لضمان الجودة، العسل الذي يحمل تصنيف MGO يتم اختباره في مختبرات معتمدة من قبل الجمعية.

The source of Sidr Al-Dawa'ni honey is the Do'an region in Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, where the Sidr trees from which the honey is collected grow.

Sidr Al-Dawaani honey is collected in a traditional way, where the bees are placed in locations close to the Sidr trees in the Al-Dawan area, and they are left for a period of time to collect the honey.

What is the source of Sidr Hadrami Doaani honey?

The source of Sidr Al-Dawa'ni honey is the Do'an region in Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, where the Sidr trees from which the honey is collected grow.

Sidr Al-Dawaani honey is collected in a traditional way, where the bees are placed in locations close to the Sidr trees in the Al-Dawan area, and they are left for a period of time to collect the honey.

Sidr trees in the Douan area are characterized by a special quality of honey due to the nature of the soil and the climate, which is characterized by drought and extreme heat. The honey is collected very carefully and manually to maintain its quality and purity.

  1. Rarity of source: Al-Dawani Hadrami Sidr honey is produced in the Doaan region of Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, which is a remote and difficult-to-reach mountainous area, making it rare and poorly produced.
  2. Short production season: Sidr Doaani honey is produced during a short period of the year, ranging from only 10 to 15 days, which makes it rarer and less productive compared to other types of honey.
  3. Product quality: Sidr Al-Dawani honey is produced from the wild Sidr tree, which is characterized by its high quality and unique flavour. Its production method relies on ancient traditions and manual skill, which makes it of very high quality.

ماذا يعني ال UMF في عسل المانوكا؟

UMF اختصار ل (Unique Manuka Factor) ويعني عامل مانوكا الفريد وهو مقياس يُستخدم لتحديد قوة وفعالية عسل المانوكا.

ماذا يعني ال MGO في عسل المانوكا؟

MGO اختصار ل (Methylglyoxal) ويعني ميثيل جليوكسال وهو مركب طبيعي يُعتبر المكون الأساسي في عسل المانوكا.

عسل شوكة أصلي أو ما يسمى بعسل الشوكيات هو أحد الأنواع المفضلة لدى الكثير من الناس ، بالإضافة إلى مذاقه الحلو اللذيذ ورائحته المنعشة الرائعة القوية التي تجذب الجميع إليها، ولذلك يمكنك تقديمه كهدية لمن يقدرون قيمة العسل الأصلي الفاخر.

مواصفات عسل شوكة السمرة الفاخر

  • لون العسل: أحمر داكن مائل إلى اللون الأسود.
  • حجم القدر : 2.5 كيلو من شمع السمرة الأصلي.
  • قوامه سميك.
  • معبأ في عبوة مصنوعة من الزجاج محكمة الغلق لضمان سلامة العسل والحفاظ عليه من أن يحدث له تكتلات أو يتحول إلى حبيبات من السكر.

تعريف عسل شوكة السمرة الفاخر

يتم الحصول على هذا العسل من النحل الذي يتغذى على رحيق زهور الأشجار الشوكية البرية الموجودة في جوف أودية منطقة الجزيرة العربية والتي تزدهر في فصل الصيف ولهذا السبب لا يتوفر هذا العسل طوال العام.

أسئلة شائعة

ما هي أهم النصائح التي يجب أن تنتبه لها قبل استخدامك عسل شوكة السمرة؟

يجب عليك التأكد من أنك قمت بشراء العسل الأصلي وليس المغشوش وذلك عن طريق شرائه من متاجر موثوق بها، أو أنك تقوم بفحصه في المختبر، وبعد شرائك العسل يجب وضعه في درجة حرارة مناسبة له أي درجة حرارة الغرفة العادية حتى لا يفقد جودته وقيمته الغذائية العالية؟

هل عسل شوكة السمرا له آثار جانبية؟

 لا، فهو مصنوع ومعبأ ومغلف بعناية شديدة بالإضافة إلى أنه خالي من أي إضافات أو مواد حافظة تقلل من أهميته الغذائية.

The opinion of the General Supervisor of the Honey Quality Laboratory in Riyadh, Dr. Ibrahim Al-Arifi, on Manuka honey:



A quarter kilo (250 grams) of 100% Manuka honey, without any additives, imported from New Zealand, produced by: Homeland

Which provides natural Manuka honey, and is a member of the New Zealand Manuka Honey Producers Association (UMFHA) .

Our Manuka honey is produced, harvested and packaged within New Zealand, and each batch is independently quality tested, meaning you can be absolutely sure that what you are receiving is 100% genuine Manuka honey, meeting the requirements set by the New Zealand Government, the New Zealand Ministry of Primary Industries (MPI) and the New Zealand Manuka Honey Producers Association (UMFHA ).


What does UMF mean in Manuka honey?

UMF stands for Unique Manuka Factor and is a measure used to determine the strength and potency of Manuka honey.

UMF is determined by the New Zealand Manuka Honey Association. This association is the officially recognised body responsible for testing and grading Manuka honey based on strict quality assurance standards. Honey that carries the UMF label is tested in laboratories accredited by the association.


What does MGO mean in Manuka honey?

MGO stands for Methylglyoxal , a natural compound that is the main ingredient in Manuka honey.

MGO is determined by the New Zealand Manuka Honey Association. This association is the officially recognised body responsible for testing and grading Manuka honey based on strict quality assurance criteria. Honey that carries an MGO rating is tested in laboratories accredited by the association.

بقية المدن: شحن خلال 1-3 أيام (متاح الدفع عند الاستلام بالطلب عبر الواتساب).

مكونات العرض:

1) عسل سدر كشميري جديد (بسعر الجملة) (3 كيلو) درجة أولى قطفة هذا العام بخصم (22% + شحن مجاني لجميع مدن المملكة).

2) 3 عبوات تلبينة نبوية ( دقيق شعير) وزن 1.5 كيلو. (هدية)🎁

3) مجاناً ملعقة عسل خشبية.



يكفيك هذا الجالون 150 ملعقة كبيرة، كل ملعقة بوزن 20 جراماً من العسل السدر الكشميري والذي يغنيك تماماً عن سكر المائدة (السكر الأبيض)، ويغنيك أيضاً عن الشيرة المصنعة بالسكر بالتعويض عنهما بالتحلية الطبيعية بالعسل السدر الكشميري الأصلي المفحوص مخبريًا.




قائمة بأسئلة عملاءنا الكرام المتكررة عن العسل السدر الكشميري:

س: ما كيفية الحصول على العسل السدر الكشميري؟

  1. اضغط زر (إضافة للسلة) أسفل الشاشة وتابع الدفع إلكترونيًا بكل سهولة.
  2. أو اطلبه عبر الواتساب، تحدث الآن مع أحد موظفي خدمة العملاء (متاح طوال 24 ساعة):

س: هل سعر العرض شامل الضريبة والشحن؟

ج: نعم، والشحن مجاني.


س: هل التوصيل والشحن مجاني إلى باب البيت؟

ج: نعم، ستستلمه عند باب بيتك والدفع للمندوب إما كاش أو شبكة.


س: هل يمكن الحصول عليه بالتقسيط؟

ج: نعم على 4 أقساط لمدة 3 أشهر، كل شهر 74.75 ريالاً بدون زيادات أو رسوم على الدفع المقدم كاملاً، اختر أثناء الدفع الإلكتروني الدفع بواسطة (tabby) أو (tamara) كما في الصورة:

س: هل يمكن الدفع عند الاستلام كاش أو شبكة داخل أو خارج مدينة الرياض؟

ج: نعم، تحدث معنا عبر الواتساب [انقر هنا للتحدث معنا] لتسجيل طلبك الدفع عند الاستلام عند باب منزلك.


س: متى يصل الطلب؟ وما هي شركة الشحن؟

ج: التوصيل إلى باب المنزل في مدينة الرياض والمدينة المنورة مساء اليوم بواسطة مندوب المتجر للطلبات المسجلة قبل الظهر أو خلال 24 ساعة.

الشحن خارج الرياض بواسطة شركة J&T Express ما بين 1-3 أيام عمل في المدن الرئيسية، وقد تصل إلى 5 أيام في غير المدن الرئيسية حسب ضغط مواسم التسوق على شركات الشحن.


س: كيف أتتبع مسار الشحنة؟

ج: بعد اعتماد طلبك وتسليمه لشركة J&T Express سيصل جوالك رسالة SMS برابط التتبع من J&T Express.


س: كيف نسلم من غش العسل السدر الكشميري؟

  1. بعد وصول العسل إلى المملكة يتم فحص العسل في مختبر جودة العسل بالرياض للتأكد النهائي من سلامة العسل للاستهلاك الآدمي.
  2. نعتني بجودة التخزين والتهوية في درجة حرارة 20-25 مئوية للعسل في مستودعاتنا، لضمان عدم تعرض العسل للتلف بسبب الحرارة العالية.
  3. سيتم إرفاق شهادة فحص العسل السدر الكشميري الحديثة من مختبر جودة العسل بالرياض في طلبك أثناء الشحن.



س: أيهما أفضل: العسل السدر الكشميري أم السدر البشاوري؟

ج: كلا الصنفين لهما مزايا خاصة حسب احتياج المستهلك واستخداماته، والخلاصة هي:

  1. العسل السدر الكشميري ينتجه النحل من أزهار المرعى ومن أزهار السدر، ولكن يغلب عليه أزهار المرعى بخلاف العسل البشاوري، فتركيز السدر فيه واضح.
  2. تكلفة العسل السدر الكشميري أقل من تكلفة عسل السدر البشاوري، لذا ففرق السعر واضح على المستهلك النهائي.
  3. يفضل المستهلك استخدام العسل السدر الكشميري بكثرة وبمعدل عالي في بدائل التحلية الطبيعية وفي صنع الشيرة عوضًا عن سكر المائدة الأبيض بحكم أن العسل السدر الكشميري طبيعي بخلاف السكر والشيرة المصنعة الضارة، إذ جالون 5 كيلو من العسل السدر الكشميري فيه 150 ملعقة عسل كبيرة.
  4. حلاوة العسل السدر الكشميري واضحة بخلاف عسل السدر البشاوري، لذا فتحلية الشاي وبعض أنواع القهوة كالقهوة التركية والحلويات ستكون رائعة المذاق وأكثر أمانًا من التحلية بالسكر الأبيض الاصطناعي.
  5. يفضل المستهلكون استخدام عسل السدر البشاوري لكون السدر فيه واضح ولأجل الحصول على منافع السدر تحديدًا، ولأنه أرخص عسل سدر طبيعي بخلاف أعسال السدر البلدية والمحلية الأخرى عالية التكلفة.


س: كيف استخدم العسل السدر الكشميري كبديل طبيعي للشيرة المصنعة؟

ج: يمكن إخفاء نكهة العسل وذلك قبل إضافته إلى الحلويات بإضافة الهيل المطحون او القرفة أو حتى الفانيلا إليه، ولن يلاحظ أفراد الأسرة الفرق.


هل هناك أوزان وعروض أقل من 3 كيلو للتجربة؟

ج: تصفح الأوزان الأخرى من العسل السدر الكشميري [من هنـــــــــــا].


س: هل يمكن شراء حبوب اللقاح وغذاء الملكات بدون العسل؟

ج: للحصول على حبوب لقاح النحل [من هنـــــــــــا] ، وللحصول على غذاء الملكات [من هنـــــــــــا].


س: هل يتبلور العسل السدر الكشميري؟

ج: نادر جداً، ومن الأخطاء الشائعة الاعتقاد بأن التبلور يدل على فساد العسل بل على العكس فالتبلور من صفات العسل الطبيعي.


س: كيف نحافظ على جودة العسل السدر الكشميري أطول فترة ممكنة؟

ج: صلاحية العسل سنتين من تاريخ الإنتاج والبيع، وأكثر من سنتين لا يُسمح ببيعه تجارياً وإن كان صالحاً للاستخدام، وأعداء العسل أربعة:

  • الحرارة. (يجب المحافظة على العسل ما بين 10 - 25 درجة مئوية).
  • الرطوبة. (تجنب وضعه في الثلاجة أو الفريزر أو كشف غطاء العسل).
  • الضوء. (احتفظ بالعسل داخل الدواليب بعيداً عن الضوء وأشعة الشمس)
  • الأوعية المعدنية. (احتفظ بالعسل في وعاء زجاجي مخصص للعسل).


س: هل وزن الجالون 3 لتر؟

ج: لا يُقاس العسل باللتر بل بالكيلو، فهو على الميزان 3 كيلو مع وزن الجالون .


س: هل هناك شهادة فحص للعسل السدر الكشميري؟

ج: شاهد نتيجة الفحص الحديثة من مختبر جودة العسل بالرياض:


سااارع قبل نفاد الكمية .. فالكمية محدودة!!.

اضغط على زر (إضافة للسلة) أسفل الشاشة وواصل إجراء الطلب والدفع دون انتظار!.

أو اطلبه الآن بالتحدث مع خدمة العملاء وسجل طلبك عبر نقر أيقونة الواتسآب أسفل الشاشة.


  • من نحن:

نحن مؤسسة روضة الجبال التجارية لتجارة العسل والتمور والمواد الغذائية بالرياض والمدينة المنورة (3 فروع).

خبرتنا تمتد لأكثر من 36 عامًا في تجارة العسل.

سجل تجاري: 1010229255

الرقم الضريبي: 300040438200003


  • فروعنا (اضغط على رابط لوكيشن أحد الفروع أدناه):

فروع مدينة الرياض:

  1. فرع الروابي، شارع السندس.
  2. فرع الفيحاء، شارع هارون الرشيد.


فرع المدينة المنورة:

فرع الوبرة، خلف المنار مول.


  • لماذا تشتري منا ؟!
  1. تم فحص العسل في المختبر وتأكدنا من سلامة جودته وأنه عسل طبيعي (يمكنك طلب شهادة الفحص).
  2. نضمن سلامة الجودة 100%.
  3. يحق لك الإرجاع خلال 7 أيام.
  4. نضمن جودة التخزين ووصول المنتج إليك بشكل سليم.
  5. الدفع متاح كاش أو شبكة لاسلكية عند الاستلام.
  6. الدفع الإلكتروني لجميع المدن متاح بواسطة بطاقات مدى أو الإئتمانية أو Appl Pay أو STC Pay أو بالتقسيط المريح لمدة أربعة أشهر عبر شركة (تابي) التي تجدها في صفحة الدفع.
  7. التوصيل داخل الرياض: خلال 24 ساعة.
  8. التوصيل خارج الرياض: عن طريق J&T Express (1-3 أيام).
  9. أجرة مندوب التوصيل والشحن: مجانًا.


  • تنبيه:
  1. لا يحق لنا ولجميع شركات العسل الإدلاء بفوائد هذا العسل الطبية بأمر من هيئة الغذاء والدواء!، -عليك وحدك البحث عن فوائده-.
  2. لا نبيع الأعسال المصنعة أو المبسترة أو الأعسال المتغذية نحلها على السكر.

What is the source of Al-Osaimi Sidr honey and why is it called Al-Osaimi and Royal honey?

This type of honey with wax comes from the extract of bees collecting the flowers of Sidr trees in the Al-Osaimat area in Amran Governorate in Yemen. It is nicknamed “Royal” because it is the most luxurious and expensive type of honey, and it has its own and continuing pioneers, including the wealthy, notables, and businessmen.


Why is Sidr Al Osaimi honey considered the most expensive type of honey in the world?

  1. Osaimi honey is famous for its high price due to the high demand for it among businessmen, especially the elderly, in the Gulf countries.
  2. Low annual supply.
  3. It is difficult to obtain it except on special recommendations by travelers to Yemen.
  4. It is considered one of the very luxurious and precious gifts that honors the face of its owner to the recipient.


What distinguishes Sidr Al-Osaimi wax honey from other honeys?

  1. This honey is characterized by being the most delicious honey you can taste among dozens of honey varieties on the market, according to the testimony of many honey experts and honey customers.
  2. Sidr Al-Osaimi honey is superior to Sidr Hadrami honey in quality, taste and efficiency, according to the testimony of those who know it.
  3. It is suitable for luxurious gifting , especially gifts for couples about to get married, parents, prominent figures, and businessmen and women.
  4. The wax from honey is natural and produced by bees, and this causes a lack of supply and high costs for merchants, and because producing wax from bees takes time, unlike the installation of imported artificial wax in some apiaries, which helps to raise productivity.
  5. We are proud of our distinctive specialization in the market in selling this luxurious type of honey after examining it in the honey quality laboratory and ensuring its safety before putting it up for sale. This is what distinguishes us most in your store, Rawdat Al-Jabal Honey.


Is pure Osaimi honey better or waxed?

What is the source of Sidr Hadrami Doaani honey?

The source of Sidr Al-Dawa'ni honey is the Do'an region in Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, where the Sidr trees from which the honey is collected grow.

Sidr Al-Dawaani honey is collected in a traditional way, where the bees are placed in locations close to the Sidr trees in the Al-Dawan area, and they are left for a period of time to collect the honey.

Sidr trees in the Douan area are characterized by a special quality of honey due to the nature of the soil and the climate, which is characterized by drought and extreme heat. The honey is collected very carefully and manually to maintain its quality and purity.

Why is Sidr Al Osaimi honey considered the most expensive type of honey in the world?

  1. Rarity of source: Al-Dawani Hadrami Sidr honey is produced in the Doaan region of Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, which is a remote and difficult-to-reach mountainous area, making it rare and poorly produced.
  2. Short production season: Sidr Doaani honey is produced during a short period of the year, ranging from only 10 to 15 days, which makes it rarer and less productive compared to other types of honey.
  3. Product quality: Sidr Al-Dawani honey is produced from the wild Sidr tree, which is characterized by its high quality and unique flavour. Its production method relies on ancient traditions and manual skill, which makes it of very high quality.
  4. Global demand: Hadrami Sidr honey is internationally famous and is exported to many countries, which increases the demand for it and makes it enjoy a high value in the market.

A list of our valued customers’ frequently asked questions about Sidr Al-Bashawari honey:

Q: Why is the price of your Al-Bashawari Sidr honey expensive compared to competitors’ Sidr honey?

As a matter of transparency and our bet on quality to gain the satisfaction of our customers, we advise you to do the following:

  1. First ask about the source of Sidr honey, the country of origin, and the year of production.
  2. Cheap Sidr honey prices are usually sourced from China and India, with a percentage of less than 70% of the Pakistani Peshawari Sidr honey . It is very unfortunate that competitors do not declare the source of the Sidr honey, and whether it is pure Sidr honey with a high concentration of Sidr tree flowers or mixed with pasture flowers in the production environment!
  3. The price of Saudi and Yemeni Sidr honey is more than 200% to 400% higher than the Pakistani Bashawari Sidr honey due to the difficulty of production and the high operational costs for the merchant.
  4. Pakistani Sidr Al-Bashawari honey is located in the middle of prices between India and China on the one hand, and between Saudi Arabia and Yemen on the one hand.
  5. Despite the legality of importing Chinese and Indian honey, meeting all Saudi specifications and standards, and being subject to all checks, our valued customers are very reluctant to buy Chinese and Indian honey once the country of origin of Sidr honey is declared!! Therefore, we do not sell Sidr honey imported from China and India!
  6. We mentioned the source of all our honey.
  7. Make sure that the Sidr honey from the competitor is laboratory-tested and that it is from the flowers of the Sidr tree and not from the pasture flowers.
  8. The consistency and viscosity of Sidr honey is heavy, as in Sidr Al-Bashawari honey. If it is light, this indicates that the bees’ nutrition from pasture flowers is high, their predominance in nutrition from the flowers of Sidr trees in the same environment, or poor storage at high temperatures.
  9. Make sure that the Food and Drug Administration accredits the country of origin and that the exporting authority in that country is accredited. Prices vary from one country to another and from one type of honey to another type of honey.
  10. Search the local market for its fair price according to its source and year of production, and you are free to choose.

  4. Very high rating from previous customers, with them constantly coming back to get it again.

  6. Suitable for gifting.

Q: What is the source of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey?

A: Peshawar Province in Pakistan.

  1. Try this product before purchasing a larger quantity and judge for yourself, we trust our products.

  4. We take care of the quality of storage and ventilation at a temperature of 20-25 degrees Celsius for the honey in our warehouses, to ensure that the honey is not damaged due to high temperature.

Q: Does Sidr Al-Bashawari honey crystallize?

A: It is very rare, and one of the common mistakes is to believe that crystallization indicates spoilage of honey. On the contrary, crystallization is one of the characteristics of natural honey.


Q: How do we maintain the quality of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey for as long as possible?

A: The shelf life of honey is two years from the date of production and sale, and for more than two years it is not permitted to be sold commercially even if it is fit for use. The enemies of honey are four:

  • the heat. (Honey must be maintained between 10 - 25 degrees Celsius).
  • Humidity. (Avoid placing it in the refrigerator or freezer or uncovering the honeycomb lid).
  • the light. (Keep honey inside cupboards away from light and sunlight)
  • Metal vessels. (Keep honey in a glass jar designated for honey.)

يتم تحديدال UMF من قبل جمعية عسل مانوكا النيوزيلندية هذه الجمعية هي الجهة المعترف بها رسميًا والمسؤولة عن اختبار وتصنيف عسل المانوكا بناءً على معايير صارمة لضمان الجودة، العسل الذي يحمل تصنيف UMF يتم اختباره في مختبرات معتمدة من قبل الجمعية.


ماذا يعني ال MGO في عسل المانوكا؟

MGO اختصار ل (Methylglyoxal) ويعني ميثيل جليوكسال وهو مركب طبيعي يُعتبر المكون الأساسي ا في عسل المانوكا.

تم تحديدال MGO من قبل جمعية عسل مانوكا النيوزيلندية هذه الجمعية هي الجهة المعترف بها رسميًا والمسؤولة عن اختبار وتصنيف عسل المانوكا بناءً على معايير صارمة لضمان الجودة، العسل الذي يحمل تصنيف MGO يتم اختباره في مختبرات معتمدة من قبل الجمعية.

حنا ما نبيعك عسل وبس، حنا نبي نكسبك زبون دائم وتثق فينا:

A quarter kilo (250 grams) of 100% Manuka honey, without any additives, imported from New Zealand, produced by: Homeland

Which provides natural Manuka honey, and is a member of the New Zealand Manuka Honey Producers Association (UMFHA) .

Our Manuka honey is produced, harvested and packaged within New Zealand, and each batch is independently quality tested, meaning you can be absolutely sure that what you are receiving is 100% genuine Manuka honey, meeting the requirements set by the New Zealand Government, the New Zealand Ministry of Primary Industries (MPI) and the New Zealand Manuka Honey Producers Association (UMFHA ).


What does UMF mean in Manuka honey?

UMF stands for Unique Manuka Factor and is a measure used to determine the strength and potency of Manuka honey.

UMF is determined by the New Zealand Manuka Honey Association. This association is the officially recognised body responsible for testing and grading Manuka honey based on strict quality assurance standards. Honey that carries the UMF label is tested in laboratories accredited by the association.


What does MGO mean in Manuka honey?

MGO stands for Methylglyoxal , a natural compound that is the main ingredient in Manuka honey.

MGO is determined by the New Zealand Manuka Honey Association. This association is the officially recognised body responsible for testing and grading Manuka honey based on strict quality assurance criteria. Honey that carries an MGO rating is tested in laboratories accredited by the association.

What does UMF mean in Manuka honey?

UMF stands for Unique Manuka Factor and is a measure used to determine the strength and potency of Manuka honey.

UMF is determined by the New Zealand Manuka Honey Association. This association is the officially recognised body responsible for testing and grading Manuka honey based on strict quality assurance standards. Honey that carries the UMF label is tested in laboratories accredited by the association.


What does MGO mean in Manuka honey?

MGO stands for Methylglyoxal , a natural compound that is the main ingredient in Manuka honey.

MGO is determined by the New Zealand Manuka Honey Association. This association is the officially recognised body responsible for testing and grading Manuka honey based on strict quality assurance criteria. Honey that carries an MGO rating is tested in laboratories accredited by the association.

What does UMF mean in Manuka honey?

UMF stands for Unique Manuka Factor and is a measure used to determine the strength and potency of Manuka honey.

What is the source of Sidr Hadrami Doaani honey?

The source of Sidr Al-Dawa'ni honey is the Do'an region in Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, where the Sidr trees from which the honey is collected grow.

Sidr Al-Dawaani honey is collected in a traditional way, where the bees are placed in locations close to the Sidr trees in the Al-Dawan area, and they are left for a period of time to collect the honey.

Sidr trees in the Douan area are characterized by a special quality of honey due to the nature of the soil and the climate, which is characterized by drought and extreme heat. The honey is collected very carefully and manually to maintain its quality and purity.

Why is Sidr Al Osaimi honey considered the most expensive type of honey in the world?

  1. Rarity of source: Al-Dawani Hadrami Sidr honey is produced in the Doaan region of Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, which is a remote and difficult-to-reach mountainous area, making it rare and poorly produced.
  2. Short production season: Sidr Doaani honey is produced during a short period of the year, ranging from only 10 to 15 days, which makes it rarer and less productive compared to other types of honey.
  3. Product quality: Sidr Al-Dawani honey is produced from the wild Sidr tree, which is characterized by its high quality and unique flavour. Its production method relies on ancient traditions and manual skill, which makes it of very high quality.
  4. Global demand: Hadrami Sidr honey is internationally famous and is exported to many countries, which increases the demand for it and makes it enjoy a high value in the market.

Q: Why is the price of your Al-Bashawari Sidr honey expensive compared to competitors’ Sidr honey?

  1. First ask about the source of Sidr honey, the country of origin, and the year of production.

  6. We mentioned the source of all our honey.

A list of our valued customers’ frequently asked questions about Sidr Al-Bashawari honey:

Q: Why is the price of your Al-Bashawari Sidr honey expensive compared to competitors’ Sidr honey?

As a matter of transparency and our bet on quality to gain the satisfaction of our customers, we advise you to do the following:

  1. First ask about the source of Sidr honey, the country of origin, and the year of production.
  2. Cheap Sidr honey prices are usually sourced from China and India, with a percentage of less than 70% of the Pakistani Peshawari Sidr honey . It is very unfortunate that competitors do not declare the source of the Sidr honey, and whether it is pure Sidr honey with a high concentration of Sidr tree flowers or mixed with pasture flowers in the production environment!
  3. The price of Saudi and Yemeni Sidr honey is more than 200% to 400% higher than the Pakistani Bashawari Sidr honey due to the difficulty of production and the high operational costs for the merchant.
  4. Pakistani Sidr Al-Bashawari honey is located in the middle of prices between India and China on the one hand, and between Saudi Arabia and Yemen on the one hand.
  5. Despite the legality of importing Chinese and Indian honey, meeting all Saudi specifications and standards, and being subject to all checks, our valued customers are very reluctant to buy Chinese and Indian honey once the country of origin of Sidr honey is declared!! Therefore, we do not sell Sidr honey imported from China and India!
  6. We mentioned the source of all our honey.
  7. Make sure that the Sidr honey from the competitor is laboratory-tested and that it is from the flowers of the Sidr tree and not from the pasture flowers.
  8. The consistency and viscosity of Sidr honey is heavy, as in Sidr Al-Bashawari honey. If it is light, this indicates that the bees feed on pasture flowers and their predominance in feeding on the flowers of Sidr trees in the same environment, or poor storage at high temperatures.
  9. Make sure that the Food and Drug Administration has approved the country of origin and that the exporting authority in that country is accredited. Prices vary from country to country and from one type of honey to another.
  10. Search the local market for its fair price according to its source and year of production, and you are free to choose.

  3. The smell of sidr in this honey is highly concentrated and has a heavy consistency, unlike Kashmiri, Chinese and Indian sidr honey.
  4. Very high rating from previous customers, with them constantly coming back to get it again.
  5. Delicious taste and suitable for children.
  6. Suitable for gifting.
  7. It is suitable for use when there is a high consumption of natural honey for sweetening and preparing meals, sweets and bites.
  8. Pure, fresh, natural raw honey, non-industrial, without any additives.
  9. An accredited laboratory examination certificate was obtained from the (Honey Quality Laboratory in Riyadh), which states that the honey is suitable for human consumption.
  10. The entity exporting honey from the country of origin is accredited on the Food and Drug Authority website.


Q: What is the source of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey?

A: Peshawar Province in Pakistan.


Q: How can we be safe from adulteration of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey?

  1. Try this product before purchasing a larger quantity and judge for yourself, we trust our products.
  2. Any type of honey cannot be imported from outside the Kingdom except from food facilities exporting to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia approved on the Food and Drug Authority website only, and customs cannot be bypassed due to this strict condition in order to avoid suspicious entities producing honey around the world.
  3. After the honey arrives in the Kingdom, the honey is examined in the honey quality laboratory in Riyadh to confirm the final safety of the honey for human consumption.
  4. We take care of the quality of storage and ventilation at a temperature of 20-25 degrees Celsius for honey in our warehouses, to ensure that the honey is not damaged due to high temperature.
  5. A certificate of inspection of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey from the Honey Quality Laboratory in Riyadh will be attached to your order during shipping.

A: After your order is approved and delivered to J&T Express, your mobile phone will receive an SMS with a tracking link from J&T Express.


Q: Does Sidr Al-Bashawari honey crystallize?

A: It is very rare, and one of the common mistakes is to believe that crystallization indicates spoilage of honey. On the contrary, crystallization is one of the characteristics of natural honey.


Q: How do we maintain the quality of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey for as long as possible?

A: The shelf life of honey is two years from the date of production and sale, and for more than two years it is not permitted to be sold commercially even if it is fit for use. The enemies of honey are four:

  • the heat. (Honey must be maintained between 10 - 25 degrees Celsius).
  • Humidity. (Avoid placing it in the refrigerator or freezer or uncovering the honeycomb lid).
  • the light. (Keep honey inside cupboards away from light and sunlight)
  • Metal vessels. (Keep honey in a glass jar designated for honey.)

UMF stands for Unique Manuka Factor and is a measure used to determine the strength and potency of Manuka honey.

MGO stands for Methylglyoxal , a natural compound that is the main ingredient in Manuka honey.

What is the source of Sidr Hadrami Doaani honey?

The source of Sidr Al-Dawa'ni honey is the Do'an region in Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, where the Sidr trees from which the honey is collected grow.

Sidr Al-Dawaani honey is collected in a traditional way, where the bees are placed in locations close to the Sidr trees in the Al-Dawan area, and they are left for a period of time to collect the honey.

Sidr trees in the Douan area are characterized by a special quality of honey due to the nature of the soil and the climate, which is characterized by drought and extreme heat. The honey is collected very carefully and manually to maintain its quality and purity.

Why is Sidr Al Osaimi honey considered the most expensive type of honey in the world?

  1. Rarity of source: Hadrami Sidr honey is produced in the Doaan region of Hadhramaut Governorate in Yemen, which is a remote and difficult-to-reach mountainous region, making it rare and poorly produced.
  2. Short production season: Sidr Douani honey is produced during a short period of the year, ranging from only 10 to 15 days, which makes it rarer and less productive compared to other types of honey.
  3. Product quality: Sidr Al-Dawani honey is produced from the wild Sidr tree, which is characterized by its high quality and unique flavour. Its production method relies on ancient traditions and manual skill, which makes it of very high quality.
  4. Global demand: Hadrami Sidr honey is internationally famous and is exported to many countries, which increases the demand for it and makes it enjoy a high value in the market.

A list of our valued customers’ frequently asked questions about Sidr Al-Bashawari honey:

Q: Why is the price of your Al-Bashawari Sidr honey expensive compared to competitors’ Sidr honey?

As a matter of transparency and our bet on quality to gain the satisfaction of our customers, we advise you to do the following:

  1. First ask about the source of Sidr honey, the country of origin, and the year of production.
  2. Cheap Sidr honey prices are usually sourced from China and India, with a percentage of less than 70% of the Pakistani Peshawari Sidr honey . It is very unfortunate that competitors do not declare the source of the Sidr honey, and whether it is pure, highly concentrated Sidr from Sidr tree flowers or mixed with pasture flowers in the production environment!
  3. The price of Saudi and Yemeni Sidr honey is more than 200% to 400% higher than the Pakistani Bashawari Sidr honey due to the difficulty of production and the high operational costs for the merchant.
  4. Pakistani Sidr Al-Bashawari honey is located in the middle of prices between India and China on the one hand, and between Saudi Arabia and Yemen on the one hand.
  5. Despite the legality of importing Chinese and Indian honey, meeting all Saudi specifications and standards, and being subject to all checks, our valued customers are very reluctant to buy Chinese and Indian honey once the country of origin of Sidr honey is declared!! Therefore, we do not sell Sidr honey imported from China and India!
  6. We mentioned the source of all our honey.
  7. Make sure that the Sidr honey from the competitor is laboratory-tested and that it is from the flowers of the Sidr tree and not from the pasture flowers.
  8. The consistency and viscosity of Sidr honey is heavy, as in Sidr Al-Bashawari honey. If it is light, this indicates that the bees’ nutrition from pasture flowers is high, their predominance in nutrition from the flowers of Sidr trees in the same environment, or poor storage at high temperatures.
  9. Make sure that the Food and Drug Administration accredits the country of origin and that the exporting authority in that country is accredited. Prices vary from one country to another and from one type of honey to another type of honey.
  10. Search the local market for its fair price according to its source and year of production, and you are free to choose.


A picture of the flowers of the Sidr tree (buckthorn or Hebrew), from which the bee feeds on its nectar to produce Sidr honey:

Q: What are the advantages of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey over other types of honey?

  1. The percentage of sucrose shown in the laboratory test certificate is very low (0.5%), and the permissible limit is (5%), which is suitable for those with diets.
  2. The price is very suitable for Sidr honey lovers, with high quality compared to local Sidr honey varieties.
  3. The smell of sidr in this honey is highly concentrated and has a heavy consistency, unlike Kashmiri, Chinese and Indian sidr honey.
  4. Very high rating from previous customers, with them constantly coming back to get it again.
  5. Delicious taste and suitable for children.
  6. Suitable for gifting.
  7. It is suitable for use when there is a high consumption of natural honey for sweetening and preparing meals, sweets and bites.
  8. Pure, fresh, natural raw honey, non-industrial, without any additives.
  9. An accredited laboratory examination certificate was obtained from the (Honey Quality Laboratory in Riyadh), which states that the honey is suitable for human consumption.
  10. The entity exporting honey from the country of origin is accredited on the Food and Drug Authority website.


Q: What is the source of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey?

A: Peshawar Province in Pakistan.


Q: How can we be safe from adulteration of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey?

  1. Try this product before purchasing a larger quantity and judge for yourself, we trust our products.
  2. Any type of honey cannot be imported from outside the Kingdom except from food facilities exporting to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia approved on the Food and Drug Authority website only, and customs cannot be bypassed due to this strict condition in order to avoid suspicious entities producing honey around the world.
  3. After the honey arrives in the Kingdom, the honey is examined in the honey quality laboratory in Riyadh to confirm the final safety of the honey for human consumption.
  4. We take care of the quality of storage and ventilation at a temperature of 20-25 degrees Celsius for honey in our warehouses, to ensure that the honey is not damaged due to high temperature.
  5. A certificate of inspection of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey from the Honey Quality Laboratory in Riyadh will be attached to your order during shipping.

A: Delivery to your door in Riyadh and Medina this evening by the store representative for orders registered before noon or within 24 hours.

Shipping outside Riyadh by J&T Express takes between 1-3 working days in major cities, and may reach 5 days in non-major cities depending on the pressure of the shopping seasons on shipping companies.


Q: How do I track my shipment?

A: After your order is approved and delivered to J&T Express, your mobile phone will receive an SMS with a tracking link from J&T Express.


Q: Does Sidr Al-Bashawari honey crystallize?

A: It is very rare, and one of the common mistakes is to believe that crystallization indicates spoilage of honey. On the contrary, crystallization is one of the characteristics of natural honey.


Q: How do we maintain the quality of Sidr Al-Bashawari honey for as long as possible?

A: The shelf life of honey is two years from the date of production and sale, and for more than two years it is not permitted to be sold commercially even if it is fit for use. The enemies of honey are four:

  • the heat. (Honey must be maintained between 10 - 25 degrees Celsius).
  • Humidity. (Avoid placing it in the refrigerator or freezer or uncovering the honeycomb lid).
  • the light. (Keep honey inside cupboards away from light and sunlight)
  • Metal vessels. (Keep honey in a glass jar designated for honey.)
